notes: Initial (pre-effective) N-14 8C joint proxy statement/prospectus for the reorganization of three Nuveen closed-end funds (JDD, JTA, JTD) into a newly formed closed-end fund, Nuveen Multi-Asset Income Fund (NMAI, ticker stated as the expected NYSE listing). Target Boards approved on April 22, 2021. Meeting date, record date and expected closing day are left as blanks ('[], 2021') in this draft, so meeting_date and record_date are null; expected_close is copied with the blank as printed (only the year 2021 is stated). exchange_basis is null: the excerpt states only that each Target Fund transfers its assets for newly issued Acquiring Fund common shares plus assumption of liabilities (cash only in lieu of fractional shares); it never states the valuation basis (equal aggregate NAV), which would be in 'Terms of the Reorganizations' (p.53) and Appendix A, both past the excerpt's cut. termination_date likewise not in the excerpt. Conditions: each Reorganization is also contingent on at least two of the three Target Funds obtaining shareholder approval (cross-condition, counted under shareholder_approval); the tax opinion is stated as non-waivable. Approval threshold: majority (more than 50%) of each Target Fund's outstanding common shares. Estimated reorganization costs $1,185,000 total ($405,000 / $280,000 / $500,000).
